naming.rule: A part is called by its codename. An alias is an edition label; '#' means the alias is retired and maps to no part.
naming.notes: Ingot is not the main part. Zingma takes Lite, Sonar takes Plus (official DeepSeek Harness), Zenix takes Ultra. Chromix is no longer a separate window: the browser ships integrated inside Codeix and that integrated browser is what is called Chromix.

launcher.name: Launcher Desktop
launcher.role: Asks one question: open the Editor window or the Fusion window. Product choice moved in-app as layouts (see arch/layouts.json).
